units.source_text: 随着秋凉，每天都有昆虫在他家里的铺席上死去。

en.t: As autumn grew cold, insects died every day on the mats in his house.

units.source_text: 硬翅的昆虫，一翻过身就再也飞不起来。

en.t: Hard-winged insects, once they flipped over, could never fly again.

units.source_text: 蜜蜂还可以爬爬跌跌一番，再倒下才爬不起来。

en.t: Bees could still crawl and stumble for a while, but once they fell again they could not get up.

units.source_text: 由于季节转换而自然死亡，乍看好像是静静地死去。

en.t: Dying naturally with the change of the season, they seemed at first glance to die quietly.

units.source_text: 可是走近一看，只见它们抽搐着腿脚和触觉，痛苦地拼命挣扎。

en.t: But when he came closer and looked, he saw their legs and antennae twitching as they struggled desperately in pain.

units.source_text: 这八铺席作为它们死亡的地方，未免显得太宽广了。

en.t: As a place for them to die, this eight-mat room seemed far too spacious.
